topic.title: OpenAPI Documentation Generator Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The OpenAPI Documentation Generator add-on contributes a tool that generates documentation for OpenAPI documents in HTML, DITA, or PDF format.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Developer
Oxygen JSON Editor
body.p: includes a tool for generating documentation for OpenAPI 3.0, or 3.1 documents in either JSON or YAML format, including annotations and cross references. The documentation displays information about the servers, paths, components and tags defined in the OpenAPI documents and you can choose whether the output is presented in HTML (with various sections, hyperlinks, and filtering options), DITA, or PDF.
